title: Milwaukee Day Tour from Chicago w/Optional Foliage Season Upgrade
blurb:
（For Non-foliage season tour）Visit Milwaukee’s top attractions: Harley-Davidson Museum, Public Market, Miller Brewery & Milwaukee Art Museum

Seasonal upgrade available during autumn foliage season

Enjoy breathtaking fall colors at Back Bay Park, Holy Hill Basilica, and Lake Geneva (For optional foliage tour)

Optional lake cruise to view Lake Geneva’s stunning autumn scenery

Round-trip transportation from Chicago included
